exact: lumenal face of medial-Golgi cisterna membrane
lumenal leaflet of Golgi medial cisterna membrane

definition: The membrane leaflet of the medial-Golgi cisternae that directly contacts the Golgi lumen, hosts glycosyltransferases and enzymes to modify N-linked oligosaccharides by trimming mannose and adding N-acetylglucosamine.
label: lumenal side of medial-Golgi cisterna membrane
